description: Implementation of the CustomerService interface for managing customer data, including CRUD operations, retrieval by criteria, and address geolocation.

classes.name: CustomerServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation class for customer-related operations, including retrieval, creation, update, and deletion of customer data.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers matching the provided first name.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a customer by their unique identifier.

methods.name: getByNick with storeId
methods.description: Retrieves customer by nickname within a specific store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists customers associated with a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByStore with criteria
methods.description: Lists customers by store and criteria.

methods.name: getCustomerAddress
methods.description: Gets customer address based on IP address using geolocation service, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Creates or updates a customer entity.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a customer and their attributes.
